owner_intent: Mechanicus must analyze the whole codebase and say exactly how many lines each language has.
Mechanicus must explain what each language participates in.
Mechanicus must be equipped with powerful language validators.
laws: Every language used by the repo must be counted.
Every counted language must have a role description.
Every language role must be tied to task zones.
Language validators must be explicit, not implied.
Missing validator toolchains are not pass; they are uncovered validation debt.
100% cleanliness is a target state requiring layered proof, not a claim from one linter.
Legacy dirt is baseline debt; future patches must not hide or worsen it.
cleanliness_100_definition: formatter pass or formatter policy declared
lint/static analysis pass or tool unavailable debt declared
dependency/security audit pass or risk registered
dead/unused code scan pass where supported
anti_fake_green: No single validator may claim 100% cleanliness alone.
A build pass does not prove clean code.
A formatter pass does not prove architecture.
A language count does not prove quality.
Tool unavailable must be reported as debt, not ignored.
